create_EmbeddingCacheController: create an EmbeddingCacheController instance with tp_rank, tp_size, and max_pool_size_gb for distributed embedding cache management
build_prefetch_batch: build a batch prefetch operation for missing image embeddings using req_id and image_hashes from the Mooncake cluster
insert_batch_embeddings: insert a batch of newly computed embedding tensors into the Mooncake distributed cache
test_check_prefetch_progress: test the check_prefetch_progress method to verify all TP ranks have the request batch ready
get_cached_embeddings: get cached embedding tensors from the local pool by image_hashes for model input reconstruction
